key.name: is-active
key.description: If false, the extension pauses its window tracking and UI behaviors.

key.name: disable-on-secondary-monitors
key.description: If true, Zen Maximize is completely disabled when multiple monitors are connected.

key.name: disable-auto-multi-monitor
key.description: If true, ignores the GNOME workspace configuration and never automatically disables the extension.

key.name: topbar-show-delay
key.description: Time in milliseconds the pointer must stay at the top edge before the Top Bar appears.

key.name: topbar-hide-delay
key.description: Time in milliseconds to wait before hiding the Top Bar after the pointer leaves.

key.name: dock-require-pressure-to-show
key.description: Persisted override for Ubuntu Dock/Dash to Dock pressure behavior to prevent it from resetting on boot.
